protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed: the ZIP branch extracted every namelist member without inspecting uncompressed size, compression ratio, or file count, enabling CWE-409 disk-exhaustion denial of service. CVE-2026-22870 remains PUBLISHED; CVE and GHSA both identify < 2.7.1 as affected and 2.7.1 as fixed.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed cd08be9a2e3fc7d2fc410684b425b36b44aa910f as the smallest surviving first-write commit: it directly added the unguarded ZipFile/namelist/extract loop to PackageScanner.download_compressed.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed against immediate parent 37c7d0767ba28f4df46117d478f97652594c491c: product Python code had no ZIP extraction or safe_extract path; the only ZipFile hit was unrelated evaluator test-data handling.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed: cd08be9a2e3fc7d2fc410684b425b36b44aa910f first wrote the flaw; 9337a8255606a739a8a30f2f3624279c02b78263 moved it into guarddog/utils/archives.py; mainline squash 72fe2dbf392e62d96de8609123ec59c08e99dd5b has the same tree as 9337a8255606a739a8a30f2f3624279c02b78263 and is not the BIC.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed: 72fe2dbf392e62d96de8609123ec59c08e99dd5b is an ancestor of v2.7.0, whose safe_extract still iterates zip.namelist() and calls zip.extract() with no bomb check.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed: b2e10d2f5a0e1e0f2a14ade76cbec17d5cf4df35 and advisory-cited descendant c3fb07b4838945f42497e78b7a02bcfb1e63969b are ancestors of v2.7.1; b2e10d2f5a0e1e0f2a14ade76cbec17d5cf4df35 is not an ancestor of v2.7.0.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix b2e10d2f5a0e1e0f2a14ade76cbec17d5cf4df35: it is the first guarddog commit found by -S _check_compression_bomb and adds ZIP infolist file-count/file-size aggregation plus size, ratio, and count rejection.
